Character IP builds trust: a recurring fixed character builds emotional identification with users, so products the character recommends naturally carry a sense of story and trust, rather than feeling like an ad. High content retention: comic dramas have complete narratives, and users' habit of following the series drives ongoing return visits, giving accounts far higher fan stickiness than a single product-showcase video.
